name: Alexander
bio: Alexander, along with Hymenaeus, had rejected faith and a good conscience; Paul delivered them over to Satan so that they might learn not to blaspheme (1 Timothy 1:19-20). He may be the same Alexander the coppersmith who later did Paul much harm, mentioned in 2 Timothy. A man named Alexander, a coppersmith, did Paul much harm, opposing his message; Paul warned Timothy to be on guard against him and trusted the Lord would repay him according to his deeds (2 Timothy 4:14-15).
